summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly report on new residential construction released September 20, 2022, covering August 2022 statistics. Relevant to the task: It provides the initial seasonally adjusted data required for the 'supply pipeline duration' proxy calculation for August 2022, the starting month of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 period. Table 4a lists total units under construction at 1,702 thousand, and Table 5a lists the seasonally adjusted annual rate of total completions at 1,342 thousand. These figures serve as the numerator and denominator for the ratio for this month, though marked as preliminary ('p') and subject to revision by later reports in the collection per the task's precedence rule.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly press release (CB22-174) issued October 19, 2022, reporting new residential construction statistics for September 2022. Relevant to the task: It contains Table 4a (Seasonally adjusted total units under construction at end of period) and Table 5a (Seasonally adjusted annual rate of total completions) for the United States. For the requested 2022/08–2025/05 window, it provides the September 2022 data points (Units: 1,710 thousand; Completions SAAR: 1,427 thousand) needed to calculate the 'supply pipeline duration' proxy, alongside revised figures for August 2022 (Units: 1,702 thousand; Completions SAAR: 1,345 thousand). As the most recent report for September 2022 at the time of release, its values prevail over earlier reports for that month, and the revised August figures supersede preliminary estimates from prior releases. While the document does not cover the full 2025 timeline, it supplies critical baseline data for the start of the task's period.
